answer: Because the timing is published against the forge challenge, the canyon audit can replay the ripple history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 285 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2605 identities would post 623 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
